### 14.4.1 Plot Mean Layer Profiles

Summarize the sample-level cluster contributions by layer and display their mean profiles with uncertainty bars. The code below specifies how the summary and uncertainty are calculated.

```{r step-059, eval=FALSE}
cluster_plot_df <- cluster_contribution_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster,
    layer
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(
      cluster_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sem_percent = sd(
      cluster_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(cluster_percent))),
    n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster = factor(
      cluster,
      levels = cluster_order
    ),
    layer = factor(
      layer,
      levels = layer_order
    )
  )

y_pos_line <- cluster_plot_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    ymax_line = max(
      mean_percent + sem_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    ymin_line = min(
      pmax(mean_percent - sem_percent, 0),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    yrange = ymax_line - ymin_line,
    
    yrange = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.finite(yrange) | yrange == 0,
      pmax(abs(ymax_line), 1e-10) * 0.1,
      yrange
    )
  )


pairwise_sig_line <- pairwise_sig %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -tidyselect::any_of(
      c(
        "ymax",
        "ymax_line",
        "ymin_line",
        "yrange",
        "y.position"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    y_pos_line,
    by = "cluster"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    p_adj,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y.position =
      ymax_line +
      0.10 * yrange * dplyr::row_number()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

p_line <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  cluster_plot_df,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = layer,
    y = mean_percent,
    group = 1
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = pmax(
        mean_percent - sem_percent,
        0
      ),
      ymax = mean_percent + sem_percent
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ cluster,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 4,
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(
      cluster = function(x) paste("Cluster", x)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(
      mult = c(
        0.03,
        0.15
      )
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cluster contribution among assigned cells (%)",
    title = "Fibroblast cluster contribution across dura layers"
  )


if(nrow(pairwise_sig_line) > 0){
  
  p_line <- p_line +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      data = pairwise_sig_line,
      label = "p_label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      step.increase = 0,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3
    )
}

p_line

ggsave(
  file.path(
    result_dir,
    "14.4_cluster_contribution_boxplots_line_plot.pdf"
  ),
  p_line,
  width = 6,
  height = 3.5
)
```

### 14.4.2 Inspect Profiles on Cluster-specific Scales

Repeat the layer-profile visualization using a separate vertical scale for each cluster. This emphasizes within-cluster trends; heights are not directly comparable between panels.

```{r step-060, eval=FALSE}
p_line <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  cluster_plot_df,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = layer,
    y = mean_percent,
    group = 1
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = pmax(mean_percent - sem_percent, 0),
      ymax = mean_percent + sem_percent
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ cluster,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 4,
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(

  # Individual y-axis scales for each cluster
```
